abstract: Experimental chemotherapy with choriocarcinoma transplanted in nude mice has been studying to improve the prognosis of drug resistant choriocarcinoma. In this paper the characteristics of transplanted tumors were presented. Two tumors, CC-HM-I (HM) and CC-I-JCK (JCK), were used. The characteristics of the tumors were studied in macroscopical findings, histological findings, growth curves, DNA amount analysis, LDH activity, alkaline phosphatase activity, and their isozyme patterns. Both tumors well maintained the characteristics of original and/or the beginning ones. Some differences between two tumors were pointed out. In morphology, HM was yellowish and hard tumor and the growth rate was rather slow. While, JCK was dark and soft tumor and contained a lot of bleeding and necrotic tissue. Its growth rate was quick and all of nude mice with JCK died of tumors around 50 days after transplantation. The serum level of HCG of HM was 75.8 +/- 2.8 ng/ml/g tumor and that of JCK was 117.4 +/- 6.2 ng/ml/g tumor. The good correlation between the tumor weight and the serum level of HCG was obtained in both groups. The activities of LDH and alkaline phosphatase in the tissues of JCK were about 3 times as higher as the one of HM. It was confirmed that the transplanted choriocarcinoma in nude mice was useful model for the study the nature of human choriocarcinoma and it will contribute to the establishment of the rational chemotherapy for drug resistant choriocarcinoma.
abstract_ja: 薬剤耐性絨毛癌に対する合理的な化学療法を確立するため、ヒト絨毛癌の2株(CC-HM-I (HM)およびCC-I-JCK (JCK))をヌードマウスに移植して用いた。腫瘍の特性は、肉眼所見、組織学的所見、増殖曲線、DNA量解析、LDH活性、アルカリホスファターゼ活性およびそのアイソザイムパターンにより検討した。両腫瘍とも元の腫瘍または初期の特徴を良好に維持していた。両株の間にはいくつかの相違点が認められた。形態的にはHMは黄色みを帯びた硬い腫瘍で、増殖速度はやや遅かった。一方JCKは黒色で軟らかい腫瘍で、出血や壊死組織を多く含んでいた。増殖速度は速く、JCKを移植したヌードマウスは全例、移植後約50日で腫瘍により死亡した。血清hCG値は、HMでは腫瘍1gあたり75.8±2.8 ng/ml、JCKでは117.4±6.2 ng/mlであった。両群とも腫瘍重量と血清hCG値の間に良好な相関が得られた。JCKの組織におけるLDHおよびアルカリホスファターゼの活性はHMの約3倍高かった。ヌードマウスに移植した絨毛癌は、ヒト絨毛癌の性質を研究するための有用なモデルであることが確認され、薬剤耐性絨毛癌に対する合理的な化学療法の確立に寄与すると考えられる。
